summary: Moves DXF preparation, unit previews and planning into cancellable local workers, with exact source checks before persistence.
warning: Installed post processors, saved revisions and controller output are unchanged. Browser DXF import and unit reimport now require a working local worker and stop each CPU task after 90 seconds with an explicit diagnostic. A worker failure does not fall back to blocking the page. Some large drawings previously left the page unresponsive; these may now require simplification or splitting. Cancellation before the transaction journal starts saves no project. Once persistence starts, the transaction finishes or recovers and the committed result remains authoritative.

checklist.schema: App version advances once to 0.0.691. UPID, project, saved revision, post package, machine package, engine API, execution-plan and storage transaction schemas are unchanged. Cached unit previews exist only in a preparation session and are not persisted.
checklist.events: Execution event kinds, fields, ordering, route selection and post translation are unchanged. Workers invoke the same pure parsing, unit and planning algorithms.
checklist.capabilities: Installed post capabilities are unchanged. Ordinary DXF import, unit reimport and WebMCP preparation/import use the same processor boundary. Existing agent argument schemas and explicit unit acknowledgements remain valid. Worker failure and timeout are explicit diagnostics. Pure domain clients retain their synchronous default; browser clients do not silently fall back to main-thread CPU work.
checklist.auditAndOutput: Post sandbox behavior, conformance, motion audits, controller extension/encoding/line endings/numbering/wrappers and no-default-feed behavior are unchanged. Native browser and serialized-task tests compare original source, reviewed units and planned geometry. No physical controller verification is claimed.
checklist.installationAndStorage: No installed-package, saved-revision or source migration. A narrow optional guard runs under the existing mutation lock immediately before the first file-transaction journal write. Cancelled queued imports write no journal or project. After journaling begins, durable results are not erased by late cancellation or an editor-open failure. Unit reimport rechecks the entire reviewed project and exact source after planning, preserving changed originals. Existing cache/folder transaction recovery and conflict checks remain in force.
checklist.verification: Independent source review covers the worker, controller, domain and agent boundaries; independent probes verify truthful committed receipts after late cancellation and failed editor loading. Integrated unit/integration verification passes 203 files / 2,016 tests with four workers. App and tooling TypeScript checks, production build, documentation discovery/parity (22 pages / 72 files), UPID fixtures, post conformance and complete package validation pass. The complete Chromium run passed 85 cases with one optional skip and exposed one installation test uploading through a disabled file input before installation completed. That test now waits for the verified install receipt without weakening its output assertions; both native installation cases pass on rerun. Two native worker cases cover exact CRLF/Unicode source and cancellable 5,000-line planning with a successful retry. CI repeats the full candidate verification before merge.

testedPosts.scope: Post implementation unchanged. All three current UPID and Robofil post fixtures, complete package validation and both native machine-install/output cases pass. No physical controller verification is claimed.

publicNotes.summary: DXF preparation and planning stay responsive and can be cancelled before saving begins.
changes: DXF import and source-unit review run parsing, unit previews and planning in local browser workers.
Cancel preparation or planning without saving a partial project, then retry another drawing.
A stopped or unavailable worker produces an actionable error. CPU tasks stop after 90 seconds instead of holding the page indefinitely.
Changing a project's source units rechecks the reviewed project and original source before saving, protecting edits made while planning was running.
If an import was saved but its editor could not open, the saved project remains available and the result reports what completed.
publicNotes.compatibility: Installed posts, saved revisions, geometry algorithms and output contracts are unchanged. Browser DXF processing now requires local workers and has a 90-second limit per CPU task. Existing drawing resource limits still apply.
publicNotes.action: If processing reaches the time limit, simplify or split the drawing and retry. Cancellation is available before saving starts; once an import reports a saved project, open that project instead of repeating the import.
